title: Native meso-vein MRI: image signal and spatial context
author: NeuroImage project
objective: Observe the retained original run and exactly selected third frame with full-section context, same-point magnification and explicit contrast.

scenes.title: Complete original run sections
scenes.prompt: Inspect the oblique native field of view and tissue context. Follow dark signal through neighboring sections before suggesting a vascular interpretation.
scenes.note: One original run from a healthy source participant. Stored frame index 2 is displayed, and the complete original series is retained. Samples use their original grid and frame, preserving source motion and intensity variation. Echo-time metadata awaits reconciliation between the source header and publication protocol. Named vein identification and individual variation are separate interpretation tasks.
